body:
If I understand correctly, you would like InstantSearch to not fill the URL when the search state changes.

To do so, remove the options [`urlSync`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html#struct-InstantSearchOptions-urlSync) or [`routing`](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html#struct-InstantSearchOptions-routing) that you may have in your [InstantSearch declaration](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/instantsearch.html#usage).
